decision: Ship three new source modules — src/core/audit-grant-encoder.ts (pure IO-free encoder for GrantAuditEvent→AuditEventInput and AssignmentAuditEvent→AuditEventInput), src/db/audit-grant-trail.ts (RLS-scoped queryGrantTrail that reads audit_event rows where type IN the four grant-family types inside withTenant), src/http/grant-trail.ts (GET /api/grant-trail with limit/cursor validation and static-seed fallback) — plus additive UI wiring in ra-grant-trail.jsx, with zero new DDL migrations. All grant and assignment change events are recorded as rows in the existing audit_event floor by T-0030's call-sites importing and calling the encoder. The trail is read via GET /api/grant-trail backed by audit_event (RLS-scoped, cursor-paginated). No new tenant table; known_tenant_tables.txt unchanged.

rejected_alternatives.why_not: T-0016 ADR §2 explicitly rejected this: two tables means two append-only/chain/isolation code-paths and two 152-FZ/GDPR narratives. New event types are rows in audit_event, never new tables.

rejected_alternatives.option: Encode GrantAuditEvent inline inside T-0030 HTTP handlers
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Duplicates mapping logic across multiple call-sites. If AuditEventInput shape evolves, every T-0030 call-site must change independently. A single encoder module is the single source of truth for the mapping contract.

rejected_alternatives.option: Re-define GrantAuditEvent in the encoder module
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Violates NF-2 and FE-W23-0008 compatibility: GrantAuditEvent is exported from grant-lattice.ts (T-0018 FR-7). A re-definition silently diverges the two types. The encoder imports verbatim.
Same objection as grant_log. assignment.create/assignment.revoke are two more event types in audit_event. encodeAssignmentAuditEvent provides the encoder for assignment write call-sites in T-0030.

rejected_alternatives.option: Hard dependency on T-0030 migration 030 (proposed_by/confirmed_by on grant table)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: The encoder maps values from the GrantAuditEvent object (supplied by T-0030's HTTP handler from its request body), not from the grant table directly. queryGrantTrail reads only audit_event columns (all present since migration 006). No order-of-merge constraint needed.

contracts: encodeGrantAuditEvent(e: GrantAuditEvent, nowMs: number, idOverride?: string): AuditEventInput — pure IO-free; maps kind→type, actor, subjectRoleId→subject, scope, proposedBy→proposed_by, confirmedBy→confirmed_by, capability→payload (with optional resourceFacet), nowMs→occurred_at; id from idOverride or crypto.randomUUID(); NO chain columns in output.

encodeAssignmentAuditEvent(e: AssignmentAuditEvent, nowMs: number, idOverride?: string): AuditEventInput — pure IO-free; maps kind→type, actor, employeeId→subject, orgScope→scope, roleId→payload.roleId, proposedBy→proposed_by, confirmedBy→confirmed_by, nowMs→occurred_at.

queryGrantTrail(pool: pg.Pool, tenantId: string, opts: QueryGrantTrailOpts): Promise<{rows: GrantTrailRow[]; hasMore: boolean}> — always runs inside withTenant; WHERE type IN ('grant.create','grant.revoke','assignment.create','assignment.revoke'); ORDER BY seq DESC; roleId filter: subject=$roleId OR payload->>'roleId'=$roleId; limit default 100 max 500; beforeSeq cursor; hasMore = limit+1 probe.

registerGrantTrailRoutes(router: Router, pool?: pg.Pool): void — registers GET /api/grant-trail; validates limit (1-500, default 100) and before_seq (non-negative integer); throws HttpError(400,'INVALID_PARAM') on invalid params; returns {rows: GrantTrailRow[], hasMore: boolean}; static seed fallback when pool absent or DATABASE_URL not set.
server.ts buildRouter: additive import and call registerGrantTrailRoutes(router, pool) — no other changes to server.ts.
ra-grant-trail.jsx UI wiring: useEffect fetch('/api/grant-trail') on mount; TRAIL from ra-data.jsx becomes initial/fallback state; filter tabs remain client-side; load-more uses before_seq cursor.

T-0030 seam (frozen): import {encodeGrantAuditEvent, encodeAssignmentAuditEvent} from '../core/audit-grant-encoder.js'; call before appendAuditEvent at each grant/assignment write call-site; additive only — no encoder changes needed.
Migration seam: T-0031 ships no DDL; any seed is numbered 031_*, INSERT-only into audit_event, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; known_tenant_tables.txt unchanged.
